name: Jollof Rice with Plantain
instructions:
1. Blend tomatoes, peppers, and onions into a smooth paste.
2. Boil the paste until water evaporates.
3. Fry in oil, add spices, then mix in parboiled rice.
4. Steam until cooked. Serve with fresh fried plantains.

name: Pounded Yam and Egusi Soup
instructions:
1. Boil assorted meat and dry fish until tender.
2. Blend melon seeds (egusi) and fry in palm oil.
3. Add meat stock, bitter leaf, and simmer.
4. Boil yam and pound until smooth.

name: Spicy Beef Suya
instructions:
1. Slice beef into thin strips.
2. Coat generously with suya spice (yaji).
3. Thread onto skewers.
4. Grill over high heat until charred.
5. Serve with sliced onions and tomatoes.
